name: Restore Source Selection
focusedTests: isolated application on all four official APK assets
combined application with every current optional patch
TV D-pad return from internal playback for first, middle and last visible source rows
acceptance: Selecting only Restore Source Selection shows Morphe > Playback and no unrelated patch setting
Restore source selection defaults on for a fresh preference, updates immediately, and a stored On or Off choice persists after force-stop and reboot
With the setting off, returning from internal playback retains Nuvio's original top-of-list behavior
With the setting on, returning from internal playback focuses the source that launched playback and restores its list viewport
The first, middle, last visible and far-off-screen source positions return without an out-of-range focus request
Internal playback selected through Ask every time follows the same one-shot restore path
External and browser playback retain Nuvio's native resume restoration behavior
Resolution failure, cancelled P2P consent and leaving the picker without playback do not arm a later restore
Changing addon filters, reloading sources or opening different movie and episode routes does not reuse a consumed restore
Shrinking source results use Nuvio's existing clamped index rather than crashing
The patch stores only its Boolean setting and never persists a source, URL, header, provider result or content identifier
When combined with Local Downloads, Local Media, Random Episode and all other patches, source callbacks and Morphe Playback ordering remain intact
No crash, ANR, VerifyError or fatal log occurs during source selection, playback, Back navigation or settings changes
